entries.name: Waterlogging
entries.description: Standing water on the carriageway after rain.

entries.name: Flooded road
entries.description: Water deep enough to submerge wheels or stall engines.

entries.name: Flowing water across road
entries.description: Moving water across the road (causeway, stream overflow) that can sweep vehicles.

entries.name: Water-covered pothole
entries.description: Pothole concealed by water; depth unknown.

entries.name: Mud
entries.description: Mud on the surface reducing grip.

entries.name: Slush
entries.description: Wet slurry of mud and water.

entries.name: Oil spill
entries.description: Oil on the surface; very low grip.

entries.name: Fuel spill
entries.description: Diesel or petrol on the surface; low grip and fire risk.

entries.name: Wet road
entries.description: Wet surface with increased stopping distance.

entries.name: Loose sand
entries.description: Wind-blown or spilled sand on the surface.

entries.name: Heavy rain
entries.description: Intense rainfall reducing visibility and grip.

entries.name: Dense fog
entries.description: Dense fog with visibility well below stopping distance.

entries.name: Smoke
entries.description: Smoke from fires or burning crops reducing visibility.

entries.name: Poor night visibility
entries.description: Dark unlit road with poor contrast.

entries.name: Fallen trees during storms
entries.description: Storm conditions with trees or branches falling.

entries.name: Strong crosswind
entries.description: Gusting side wind on exposed sections and bridges.
